problem_text:
A shipping company must allocate cargo space for five distinct categories of commodities, each necessitating sequential handling across five distinct logistical checkpoints.  
The revenue generated per metric ton for each commodity is as follows:  
* Commodity Alpha yields 14.791 per metric ton  
* Commodity Beta yields 14.913 per metric ton  
* Commodity Gamma yields 12.42 per metric ton  
* Commodity Delta yields 19.3 per metric ton  
* Commodity Epsilon yields 12.214 per metric ton  

The handling duration required per metric ton at each checkpoint is detailed below:  
* For Commodity Alpha, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.765 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.726, Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.666, Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.288, Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.466  
* For Commodity Beta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.679, Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.614, Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.891, Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.307, Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.269  
* For Commodity Gamma, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.508, Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.931, Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.818, Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.994, Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.506  
* For Commodity Delta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.384, Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.668, Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.409, Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.749, Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.841  
* For Commodity Epsilon, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.171, Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.518, Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.472, Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.24, Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.33  

The cumulative handling time at each checkpoint is bounded by available operational windows:  
* Checkpoint 1 cannot exceed 118.481 ton-hours  
* Checkpoint 2 cannot exceed 113.779 ton-hours  
* Checkpoint 3 cannot exceed 65.519 ton-hours  
* Checkpoint 4 cannot exceed 47.539 ton-hours  
* Checkpoint 5 cannot exceed 77.603 ton-hours  

Under the stipulation that the total processing duration at every checkpoint must remain within its respective time allocation, determine the optimal tonnage for each commodity category to maximize overall revenue.
